successful_functional_brief: Build one code Cog for a functional integration fixture. Input bundle has a texts array of strings. Return payload with total_characters equal to the sum of Python len(text) for every string, including whitespace. Empty array gives zero. Acceptance criteria: empty array returns zero; Unicode counts Python code points; multiple texts include whitespace and empty strings; malformed inputs return error problems. Include stdlib unit tests for these four criteria. Network and effect isolation are qualified separately by the deployment tests; do not add an unmeasurable universal absence-of-effects criterion to this functional contract. No external dependencies.
